metadata.scenario: A first-time caller requests information about the types of wellness programs available. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Agnes Rodriguez, and I’m looking for information about your wellness programs. Hi Agnes, I’d be happy to help with that. What specific wellness programs are you interested in? I’m not sure, I just heard that you offer various options. We do offer a range of wellness services, including personal care assistance, companion care, and specialized programs for dementia care. That sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about the companion care? Of course! Our companion care services provide social interaction, light housekeeping, and support for activities of daily living. How much does that cost? The price for companion care is typically between $25 and $30 per hour. That sounds reasonable. I’m also curious about any specialized programs for clients with dementia. We have specialized dementia and Alzheimer’s care, which is designed to help clients with cognitive impairments. What is the pricing for that service? The cost for dementia care ranges from $32 to $40 per hour, depending on the level of care needed. Great, that could be beneficial. Do you have any wellness programs focused on physical activity? Yes, we offer physical therapy services, which include rehabilitation for mobility, strength, and balance improvement. And what’s the cost for physical therapy? Physical therapy services range from $110 to $140 for a 45 to 60-minute session. That sounds like something my mother might need. How do I get started with setting up these services? I can help you with that. First, we would need to perform an assessment and develop a care plan tailored to your mother’s needs. Okay, that sounds good. What are the next steps? I can schedule a consultation for you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. Would you like me to do that? Yes, please. When is she available? Lisa is available Monday through Saturday, typically from 7 AM to 7 PM. How about tomorrow at 10 AM? Let me check that for you... Yes, Lisa is available at 10 AM tomorrow. I'll book that for you. Perfect! Thank you so much. You’re welcome, Agnes! I’ll also send you some information about our wellness programs via email. That would be great. I appreciate the help. No problem at all! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Thank you! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, Agnes. Have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
